reasoning: Arrange all p+k non-female symbols first, with C(p+k,k) possible B/M strings. Each interior gap permits zero, one, or two females; exterior gaps permit zero or one, exactly enforcing that every female has a male or guide neighbor. Thus count the coefficient of x^q in (1+x)^2*(1+x+x^2)^(p+k-1). Rewrite the second factor as (1-x^3)^(m-1)/(1-x)^(m-1) and use exact integer binomial inclusion-exclusion; no modular division is used because 10^7 is composite. If both guide and participant symbols exist, some adjacent guide/participant pair must occur in the line; otherwise the required guide condition fails. Handle m=1 directly and impossible q>2m as zero.
